content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICMR NIHR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.icmr.gov.in/, https://nihrgkp.icmr.org.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ICMR NIHR Project Human Resource Position posts is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various Project Human Resource Position posts at ICMR NIHR.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Research Scientist-III?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist-III, a Post Graduate Degree with 5 years of experience or a PhD with 2 years of experience is required. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Graduate degree with 5 years of experience or a PG degree with 3 years of experience or PhD is needed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Administrative Officer post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Field Officer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Field Officer position is Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a walk-in-interview or a written test, followed by an interview if necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official websites of ICMR and NIHR, the links for which are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is temporary.
